acceptanceCriteria.criterion: All included subtasks run without new approval

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Existing canonical Goal proposal, approval, scope, execution-window, and aggregate-budget checks remain covered and passing after the identity correction.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Pause and resume preserve remaining authorization
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Gateway-capable managed work still re-fetches canonical state for each logical check; genuinely non-BOS issues without native references retain unmanaged compatibility.

residualRisk.mitigation: Preserve the clean committed workspace; publication and fresh independent review remain owned by the subsequent Symphony delivery coordinator.

summary: Repair cycle 2 closes the malformed managed repository identity bypass while preserving unmanaged compatibility only for issues without BOS native references.
